acceptance_criteria: See the Acceptance Criteria section of change.md: skill step, installed copies, contract and docs, cold-start proof, verification.

answers.constraints: specs/cli/context.md lessons: the cold-start change run (observation) and its untested hypothesis that the code puts the facts in front of the agent but the skill never asks it to state them; record bounds in criteria; closeout order (change check refuses while tasks.md has open boxes, so human gates are plain text); listing .chough/ in affected paths stales verification; confirm an external agent can start (quota, trust dialog) before relying on a run; parallel closeouts of one change on one branch corrupt archive history, so only one session closes out. AGENTS.md: never record or infer human approval, review or grades; no new store or model client.
